notes.title: The Dev Journey (50% off for Summer sale!)
notes.content:
Hey rockstars and washed-up-has-been rockstars! Today we would like to take a moment to celebrate/discuss how far this game has come.

Tycoon games have always been held to a pretty high standard in regards to balance and pacing. The truth to it is that no game will be perfect for everyone and Rock God Tycoon is no exception. We've read reviews praising the game for being the very best tycoon game they've ever played! But we have also read reviews stating that this is the absolute worst game they've ever played. Neither side is wrong, they just enjoy different games.

With that out of the way... We are proud of how far this game has come and now we will go on a short journey following the development of Rock God Tycoon.

Was it a coincidence?
Many years ago Panos (the artist) and I met through a website called IndieDB in its job section. He had made a post requesting to team up with a programmer to create some musical tycoon game. I had never wanted to work with anyone but for some reason this seemed like a good opportunity to give it a shot. We got together in a Skype call and before we knew it we had worked the entire day on our prototype "Metalhead Tycoon". I still have the original executable and let me tell you it was a horrible game.

We then posted the game on Steam greenlight where it sat for quite a while with little to no votes or recognition and reasonably so. I went on to create another game after splitting up with Panos.

Another stroke of luck
The game I had been working on had been approved on Greenlight and coincidentally so had Metalhead Tycoon. Panos rebranded the game at some point as "Rock God Tycoon" with all new artwork. He and I talked for the first time in a LONG time where he told me that he wanted to recreate what we had started a year prior. Again without a real reason I said, "Sure!"

Days later we were both working on Rock God Tycoon! During this time I was working 40 hour weeks at a retail job and was still developing my other game (which was early access at the time) while Panos was still going to college full-time. It was only by sheer luck that we managed to get the game all the way to early access 1.5 years later.

Shocking responses
Panos and I are usually pretty cynical people and so we expected the game to flop once we entered Early Access. We were absolutely blown away when the game sold well enough for us to pay bills and all the meanwhile we were maintaining 95%+ in Steam reviews. Never before did we feel so motivated to work on this game. There were regular posts with pages of feedback and suggestions, and just so much positive/encouraging energy all around.

I don't think either of us had been that happy with ourselves before.

Fast forward
The game went into full release in February of 2017 and we again were surprised by how many people had been waiting on the game to leave Early Access. It was shortly after that time that Panos was getting a job in another country and I had to move forward with a new project. Many people felt we had abandoned the game so we came back and did a massive overhaul.

We implemented an expanded tension system that took away a lot of the normal "busk 24/7" grind that people had told us was ruining the experience. It took about a week if I recall and when we pushed it out we got mixed results. It seemed that nobody was bothered or impressed so we just left it at that. The core of the game isn't going to change with tweaks and new features.

Where we are now
Panos is working for a game company in Germany now doing what he loves and paying bills like an adult. I'm working on my 4th game whilst finishing putting my previous title onto consoles. Both of us are proud of how far we've come and with the overall experience of Rock God Tycoon (from a developer's point of view). We started with nothing, no help, and no recognition. We had to claw our way here and every inch of it was gruesome but worth it.

So why did you write all this?
There is the occasional review/comment that Rock God Tycoon is dead. Saying a game is dead puts out a very negative idea that a game is completely broken and abandoned. This is obviously not the case and we wanted to clear the air. No we are no longer working on Rock God Tycoon (actively) and we have both since moved on to new projects/jobs. We have to make bills, grow as people, and progress in our careers.

To say this game is dead is to say that we didn't put 1.5 years (and additionally updates/patches for 5 months, not mentioning minor fixes even recently) and that just sucks to hear. Especially from users with 40+ hours put  into the game.

I hope this post was an interesting read!

notes.title: Update 1.2.0.8, a much needed update!
notes.content:
Improving basd on your feedback
After a much needed break from development we're coming back to improve the quality of life for RGT. In the coming days Panos plans to bring in some more customization options for characters!

Time freeze bug
We've heard a lot of people bring up the time freezing bug and yet a ton of players were able to play upwards of 50 hours without any issues. Since it didn't seem urgent it got pushed off for a while but we're finally attempting to resolve it. I've made some changes to the code surrounding record deals and booked events that should hopefully prevent anymore time freezes from occuring. As always your feedback is crucial so if you still get the bug please exit the game and email me a copy of your save file so that I may further diagnose the issue.

Windowed mode is back
After a number of complaints we switched the game to borderless windowed instead of normal windowed but it turns out the majority actually prefers windowed mode as that allows the window to be resized freely. So we've returned to that.

Attempting to increase compatibility
This part is a bit technical but we've reduced texture page sizes in hopes of making the game more functional for less capable video cards. Not sure if this will actually solve the problems we've heard from the community but we are hopeful.

Changelog 1.2.0.8
Reduced standard texture page size from 8192x8192 to 4096x4096
Switched the game back to Windowed mode
Fixed a possible time stop bug with album finalization
Fixed a possible time stop bug with booked events such as gigs and video clips
Drug Dealer image is properly removed from memory when the popup menu is closed
Minor optimizations to script referencing throughout the game

notes.title: Update 1.2.0.3 Tension fixes, extended resolution support!
notes.content:
Tension events
Tension reducing events reduce tension by a certain percentage with each band member. This has unfortunately led to a lot of confusion. There were some bugs with tension changes not being saved properly but this has all been fixed.

Extended resolution support
I recently acquired a 4k monitor and realized that Rock God Tycoon doesn't support resolutions beyond 1920x1080. Upon seeing this I decided it was time for a small upgrade to the display system. The game window now centers properly for different resolutions and I've added support for 1366x768 as well as 1360x768 (not true 16:9 which previously led to various issues).

New hair bug?
Not sure why but this started happening...

I'm assuming it is due to the latest updates made to Game Maker but I can't say for sure. It is only this single hair style so it'll just be like this for now.

Changelog 1.2.0.3

Minor Changes
Resolution settings have been extended and now support resolutions as high as 3840x2160, and odd ones such as 1366x768, and 1360x768
Block booking of tension reducing events if there isn't enough money
Display available money on tension reducing events (except drug dealers)
Bug fixes
Window now centers properly with different resolutions
Fixed issues with tension reduction in tension reducing events
New bug
Hair bug with a single hairstyle, not sure why but can't fix it.

notes.title: Update 1.2.0.2 Balancing and optimizations!
notes.content:
Reducing the grind/difficulty
Update 1.2.0.0 resulted in an endless grind where money was barely obtainable. The game progression was slowed to nearly a stop and so we listened to what the community had to say about it. As a result of your experiences and voices we have made a number of balance changes. You should be able to progress a lot easier now and a few of the more harsh changes we made have been undone.

Polishing changes
The game now runs in borderless windowed mode which should be a lot less annoying for the majority of users (especially content creators). Additionally I spent about an hour re-writing all of the rectangle drawing in the game to use a more optimal solution that while visually is the same, should result in much better performance. You may also notice a new help icon in the hiring screen if you start a new game. This was added to help prevent new users from using all of their income on hiring initially which often leads to an instant game over.

Changelog 1.2.0.2

Balancing
Busking income changed from $7-$10, to $10-$13
Busking fan gain changed from 0-3 to 1-5
Gig burnout gain rate reduced by 50%
Reduced weed overdose gain by 25%
Reduced city hype requirement from 25% of city population to 20%
Overdose threshold raised by 20%
Overdose chance reduced by 12.5%
Minor Changes
Tooltip button added to hiring screen for first time hiring budget
Optimized rectangle draws with custom rectangle drawing, difference should be noticeable for low-end users
Changed windowed mode to borderless
Bug fixes
Stripclub in Dover now has a background image

Live Development Roadmap

notes.title: Update 1.2.0.0 is here at last! Full game rework!
notes.content:
At long last!
Generally I would write out a few paragraphs regarding the update but you can find loads of information about this update in the previous two news posts we posted.

Post #1: Click Here
Post #2: Click Here

You'll notice with these changes that the game seems completely different. Tension is handled in a new way and you'll have to manage your money a lot differently.

Changelog 1.2.0.0

Major Changes
Character Actions rework, refine skills is now practice skill allowing the player to pick a specific skill for improvement
Removed passive tension deduction at the end of each day
4 new map event types that reduce tension
UI rework for date/time on the Map menu and the main screen.
Map legend and event icons rework. Descriptions for gigs,recording studios and video clip studios are back.
Implemented gig burnout, playing shows too many times at the same location will lead to less people showing up
Rewrote algorithm behind travelling tension, no longer reduces tension and now provides consistent results
Implemented passive character action, "burn out"
Implemented passive character action, "Attending Rehab"
Implemented character overdose
Added new events to various cities
Minor Changes
Opening any menu or pausing in the main hub will stop fast forwarding sounds immediately
Tooltip showing event details has been re-positioned slightly to the left of the icon
Missing a gig due to time passing events will result in fan loss in that gig's city
Polished positioning of map tooltip for city event list
Changed games margin sleep timer from 1ms to 10ms, game should feel smoother
Made click radius for map buttons 1 pixel shorter to prevent overlapping buttons
Tension event where bandmate demands a raise increased demanded raise from 10% to 25%
Calendar tooltip uses the same system as the datebox to show event information
Datebox tooltip UI, shifts position if it is off screen
Booked event messages now shows text more centered
The map and shop transition now use lerp functions to smooth out movement (polished)
Re-balanced gig promotions to allow up to 100% increase in audience attendence (still capped by gig capacity)
Re-balanced shop promotions to better compliment latest gameplay changes
Re-balanced city fan requirements for the first 8 cities
Booked events such as gigs, studios, and video clips now give more tension
Bug fixes
Travel time tooltip on city map fixed
Fixed an issue that allowed for you to book dates that were supposed to be unavailable on the calendar
Tension and band solidity bars in the band info screen were drawn improperly, fixed
Billboard doesn't update until you scroll, fixed
Map name shown over calendar, fixed
Fixed xp level progression bars, they were not showing the right information at all
Two of the available guitar instruments were on the wrong texture page, fixed (resulting in better performance)
"Sell Songs" menu now properly bounds the mouse box within the song list area
Changed texture pages for pop up messages, improved performance
Changed texture pages for "Monthly Expenses" paper and "Randomize" to run along the Main GUI, improved performance
Dynamic images loaded onto tickets such as the billboard shown when booking a gig were not being unloaded, fixed
Save file searching now works properly as long as the "save_cache" file exists
Character portraits were drawn improperly and had inconsistent results
Character action menus overlapping sometimes didn't work

notes.title: More information on v1.2!
notes.content:
Where is the update at?
We are still working on the update and at the moment we really can't say exactly when it will be made available. A lot of the update is implemented and looks to be very promising. We want to give you a sneak peak at a few of the things this update brings.

We estimate this update will be available by the end of this week.

Tension Relief
After a hard day of jamming in the studio your band will need to find a way to release some of that pent up tension. It's up to you to decide between fast food, strip clubs, bars, or even... drugs!


The system has been designed streamline this process and make it as un-grindy as possible. Time will fast forward briefly while your bandmates tension decreases.


Polish at every corner
Various parts of the game have an extra layer of polish to ensure the game looks gorgeous long into the future. In this example you'll hopefully notice that the map transition is a lot less robotic.


Travelling System Improvement
While I (Seabass) was playing the game I noticed that if you travel a short distance, you actually lose tension and travelling long distances with the higher tier vehicles had very little effect on the band. Upon notices these things I decided it was time to rewrite the math behind travelling. I think players should notice a pretty significant difference in consistency of results.

Another issue with travelling that this update addresses is its ability to skip gigs with no punishments. Prior to this update you could travel long distances and miss shows without any negative effects. Now you will see the proper outcomes occur even while travelling.

Thanks!
We both want to thank everybody in the community for taking the time to give Rock God Tycoon a chance and by doing so... showing some faith in our team. notes.title: Update 1.1.4.2 City hype, less annoying random events
notes.content:
Quality of life
You can now toggle between the normal cursor and the Windows default cursor. F3 to toggle between the two options.


Cancelling events via the dateboxes shown at the top of the main hub has been around for a while but it wasn't really explained anywhere so there is now a tooltip for it.


City hype
In an attempt to make the mid to late game more exciting we have added city hype. What this means is that certain cities that you are popular in will reach out to you and offer to pay more to see you perform at one of their local venues. This makes the world feel more active and rewards players for sticking to cities early on. Hopefully this change makes some of the early challenges a little less difficult.

Event redundancy system
Seeing the same random events hundreds of times can get annoying. To fix this we can either add a lot more events (which would involve a lot of writing and programming) or we can extend the life time of the ones we already have. When I wrote the event system originally it did not store any information about the message after it had passed. The new system can track how many times you've seen a message and what choices you have made.

I'm slowly working my way through all the previously created events to allow for a more dynamic and less repetitive experience. An example of this is shown when getting the "dropped money" event. Instead of always saying, "You found $100!", it will instead (upon its second occurence) say, "You must be a money magnet because you found another $50!". This way it feels a little different and makes starting a new game all the more refreshing.

Changelog 1.1.4.2
New Stuff
Message redundancy system implemented
Added two new message events, (31, 32)
Added two new character descriptions
City hype, if you have at least 25% of a city population as fans, there is a chance they'll get hyped to see you perform and pay extra at venues for a limited time
Cursor can now be toggled between ingame and Windows default with F3
Event cancellation tooltip now displayed when hovering over dateboxes
Minor Changes
Reduced random event occurrence by about 18%
Flipping man, fan dream, satanic accusations, and dropped money events have redundancy message modifications
Bug fixes
Fixed bug with "Fan dream" message event that would give player $100 after clicking OK
Fixed rent displaying as "Rent divided by 12"

notes.title: Where we are at and what's next!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We would like to apologize for our short absence over the past two weeks. So here is an update on the development situation. Panos (the artist) is still working on settling in somewhere and is still unable to work on artwork at the moment. It is looking like he will be settled in by the end of next week but we can make no promises and in the meantime, we'll keep you posted.

The reason I (Seabass, the programmer) have not posted any updates over the past two weeks is because I was taking a bit of time off after handling updates and the community mostly myself for last month while Panos was away. I'd like to clarify that Panos has not abandoned the project and is actually still very passionate and motivated to work on it (as am I). I just had a lot to handle by myself last month after adding Steam Workshop support, the new calendar system, and the user music player. It was back-to-back major changes/features alongside bug reports and replying to users in the community, I just needed time to breath and refresh myself.

The good news
I am ready to return to Rock God Tycoon and continue adding more content as well as make balance changes. There are lots of suggestions we have seen from this amazing community and have added them to the development roadmap and you can expect to see some of them implemented soon. We know minor events seem lacking once you reach the mid to late game so I plan to work on more of those as well. There are currently something like 30 events but I'm sure I can come up with at least a few more alongside doing other things with the project.

The bad news
Since Panos is not available just yet I can not fully flesh out major features like Festivals or Sponsors. I will be working on the code behind most of it though and getting it ready in preparation of his return.

TL;DR (Summary)
Panos (the artist) isn't back yet but will be soon hopefully. I took a break for about two weeks but I'm back and will be working on Rock God Tycoon again as of now.

notes.title: Update 1.1.2.0 Calendar, Steam Cloud, and bug fixes
notes.content:
Calendar booking system
We have always wanted a touring system and the community has been asking for a way to book events further into the future so we decided it was time to re-design our booking system. The new calendar UI allows for you to book/cancel events as far into the future as you would like. This brings with it an obvious warning... DO NOT BOOK 50 YEARS WORTH OF EVENTS at once. It will both slow down your game and be a serious pain if you have a sudden change of plans for your band.



Steam Cloud
A single user suggested that we add Cloud support because he wasn't able to play his save file on his laptop while at work away from home. I felt so bad for him that I spent the necessary time to implement it. I'm sure this is the case for a lot of people that game outside of their home.

Stability and bug fixes
The game isn't bug free obviously as we are a small team but as the programmer, I work VERY hard to respond to and resolve as many bugs as possible. I think it is important that everyone is aware that we both care A LOT about crashes and even just pesky little bugs. Please report any you run into and you can expect that we'll fix it ASAP.

This build fixes a lot of issues and potential crashes players may have ran into previously. The list is too big to go over here so you'll have to refer to the changelog below if you are interested in specifics.

Changelog 1.1.2.0
Features
Calendar booking system
Steam Cloud support

Balancing
Recording studios with higher rating affect recording/rehearsal quality more

Minor changes
You can now cancel events by pressing Ctrl+Left MB on occupied date boxes
Santa Fe and Albuquerque are no longer in opposite positions on the map
Easton and Dover are no longer in opposite positions on the map
Confirmation message when cancelling album finalization
Maximum profit is now shown on gig booking UI
Randomize button for name choice and band choice
When writing a song that already exists in your files, you will not be prompted to write the song
The "Easy Song Access (F2)" will no longer allow you to write song names that already exists in your files
Bug fixes and performance
Studios were not properly including their quality when calculating the rehearsal experience gained
Removed username based song directory (Will automatically delete for previous users)
Wrote a conversion script to automatically convert old song files to the new name format upon launching this update or a newer one
Fixed possible crash with rehearsals due to corrupted save files
Minor event message system is now nullified by other present events, this will prevent overlapping events
Fixed memory leak and possible crashes due to the player missing recording/rehearsal events
Removed a lot of code occurences of string_hash_to_newline() that were added when porting from GMS 1 to GMS 2, this could slightly increase performance in some places
Hovering your mouse over the date boxes while a message is being displayed will no longer trigger the tooltips for it

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.4 Checkpoints, bandmate raises, and polish!
notes.content:
We are starting to get back into the flow of things and regaining momentum. You can expect awesome changes very soon. Meanwhile, enjoy this rock'n update.

XP Bars (user request)
You can now see just how far along your character is with whichever skill you are working on. The XP system uses a 1 to 100 point system for each level so you should be able to see those numbers a little easier now.


Band info menu

Band management menu


Checkpoint System (user request)
We've heard a lot of people voices regarding the persistance of save files. We intended for the game to be this way but it is unusually cruel that when you lose, you lose everything forever. So to counter act our own design for the betterment of Rock God Tycoon society, we've added a checkpoint system.

Every 6 months the game will automatically backup your save file and so next time you get a game over, it will revert to that backed up save file. That way you don't lose everything.

Difficulty, where is it?
The first run you have in RGT generally results in a game over around month 3. The 2nd run, you excel and beat the game with ease. The end game feels like nothing is happening and that you may as well start over. We've noticed this and (thanks to all of you awesome people) have made some big changes.

Two major changes include:
1. Bandmates now request increases in salary. Their request is based on the income you've made that month. This means that salary scales with your income. It isn't too ridiculous so you can still get rich easily but maintaining a band is nowhere near as easy as it once was.

2. Less fans arrive at shows. Previously 25% to 50% of fans would arrive at shows. You could busk for a week and then make lots of mulla at gigs. Now it is 14% to 16% of fans that arrive at shows. This should make promotions more viable and progression less of a landslide to victory.

Changelog 1.0.0.4
Features
Half-year checkpoint backup system

Balancing
Bandmates occasionally request salary increases (15% of monthly income)
Reduced the number of fans that arrive at gigs, previously 25% to 50% of fans arrived, now it is 14% to 16%

Minor changes
Equip button locked in when already equipped (vehicle shop menu)
Props and vehicles can now be sold via the shop
XP bars in band info/band management for skills
Scroll menu focus gained via mouse hover
Random song name button for song writing
Bug fixes
Loans would give you $1,000 at the end of each month instead of deducting it

XP Bars (user request)
You can now see just how far along your character is with whichever skill you are working on. The XP system uses a 1 to 100 point system for each level so you should be able to see those numbers a little easier now.


Band info menu

Band management menu


Checkpoint System (user request)
We've heard a lot of people voices regarding the persistance of save files. We intended for the game to be this way but it is unusually cruel that when you lose, you lose everything forever. So to counter act our own design for the betterment of Rock God Tycoon society, we've added a checkpoint system.

Every 6 months the game will automatically backup your save file and so next time you get a game over, it will revert to that backed up save file. That way you don't lose everything.

Difficulty, where is it?
The first run you have in RGT generally results in a game over around month 3. The 2nd run, you excel and beat the game with ease. The end game feels like nothing is happening and that you may as well start over. We've noticed this and (thanks to all of you awesome people) have made some big changes.

notes.title: Full release! Update 1.0.0.0
notes.content:
The big surprise
Today at 6am PST we launched into full release! Along with this changed state of release, we have brought an absolutely ridiculous amount of content. Without talking about everything we will breifly go over some of the major changes.

We want to thank everyone that has stayed  involved with the early access and has helped us improve the game to reach the state it's in today. We couldn't have done it without the amazing support and feedback from everyone.



47 more cities and more assets coming soon
Hey guys, Panos here. I have been working really hard to complete the additional 47 cities that were missing from the game. I am confident that there will be no problems with the new cities but in case I am wrong feel free to contact us. 
More content regarding instruments and props will be added soon, as well as new backgrounds for recording studios and video clip studios. If you have more awesome ideas for graphic assets you would love to see in the game feel free to let us know.

Gig reviews are working
This has been an issue with Rock God Tycoon since before early access and I just never got a chance to actually fix the issues. Now you'll see your band get 2's and 3's from reviews early on (not just 1's every time). You will also notice that reviews won't repeat themselves anymore.

Youtubers/Streamers (content creators), resolution settings
A lot of content creators have made themselves heard regarding the lack of resolution options in the game. You can now make these changes within the video settings. The resolutions available will be based on your monitors aspect ratio. You can still manually resize the window of course.

Character perks
This is another feature that has been missing since day 1. There are now 5 perks and I recommend you read the change log to find out what each of them do. We will eventually make a guide/wiki or more ingame information for all of these small side features.

New achievements
Originally there were only 11 achievements but no game is complete on Steam without at least 20 (in my opinion at least). Panos created some lovely art for the new achievements and we hope you enjoy them.

Change log, Update 1.0.0.0

Every city is now available
Modified billboard scaling to match player progression a bit better
Gig reviews would show duplicate reviewer text, this has been fixed
Gig reviews have been rebalanced to allow for slightly better reviews early on
Travel time between cities can now be viewed by hovering your mouse over the travel button on the city map
Optimized time simulation
Hiring screen perk tooltip now draws at the correct position
All message popups will make a click sound when you click a button on them
Shop menu compressed and cleaned up
Band info cleaned up
9 new achievements
Video clip/Studio booking now has additional tooltips
Rebalanced props
Releasing albums now brings in new fans
Video settings have been changed

Added resolution options
Added shader toggle
Removed vertex buffer method
Removed alternative vsync

Added perks

Performer: +5% more money from gigs
Day Job: +$30 at the end of each day
Traveller: -10% tension gained from travelling (applied after band solidity reduction)
Perfectionist: +10% recording quality for that band member



What does this mean for the future of Rock God Tycoon?
We certainly are not done updating the game and you can absolutely expect more updates in the near future. There are still bits of the game that we want to polish and add to so please don't stop giving us feedback. Our transition to full release is more due to the amount of content/stability the game now has. We don't feel that the early access state of the game (on the Steam store page) properly conveys the amount of content/features.

We are excited to be taking this next huge step and hope that everyone that has been involved with the early access release agrees with our decision. Panos and I are going to take the next few days off to relax (because so many people have been telling us to do so).

Word of mouth
We could really use your help getting the word out about Rock God Tycoon. We are a two-man team and have no way to market this game outside of our own tiny communities. We would both love to see big youtubers playing the game and all that but in todays market, it is impossible to get yourself out there.

Thanks once again to everyone and keep rockin'. ːRockSignː

New homes and new props
It has taken longer than expected but at last we present to you... Two new homes, and 12 new props! You'll have to check out the new props yourself in game under the Speakers tab in the prop shop. The new homes are unlocked through story progression which will happen naturally as you play the game. Make sure you don't slack off though because if you do, you might not be able to afford the rent!

Below is a picture of my band enjoying their new crib. Yes, my bands name is Ass.


Taking suggestions
We constantly go back to and read all of your suggestions. We ask that you post suggestions in the relevant section of the steam community hub. Commenting on someone elses thread is likely going to result in us missing it in the future. You have all been awesome so far and really have helped us improve this game. So once again, thank you to everybody who is a part of this community.

That annoying crash on exit
One of the main reasons I have spent today porting the game into the new engine is because of this crashing issue. I believe that this engine is a bit more stable than the one we've been using so we've crossed our fingers and are taking the dive. Of course we can't guarantee anything as we are tiny team and I (as the programmer) tend to do most of the playtesting so there is very little we can do to predict the future. However we got this far without too many horrible issues so you can probably trust us.

notes.title: Update 0.5.6.9, Song creation, story events, and a new apartment!
notes.content:
Song writing is here!
It took us forever but at last we have delivered to you... song writing. It appears to be fully functional and bug-free but that's the point of early access. We need you awesome people to let us know if you have any issues/crashes with this latest update. I personally played for about an hour without a crash earlier today so I'm assuming there won't be a ton of issues.

You can access song writing by completing the Write a song character action. Upon completion you will be prompted to either write the song in the song editor or skip it. We plan to make song writing more accessible in future updates but this will have to do for now.

Seabass, balancing
We have seen loads of people point out how unbalanced the game is in its current state and we completely agree. This update fixes all of that and from my personal play testing, really improves on the whole experience. The difficult has been smoothed out just a bit and character actions have been tweaked.

You can no longer force your band to write songs constantly and live off of the sales. Songs you sell have been nerfed tremendously. This might make the game a bit more difficult but it really does force you to actually play the game and not just spam songs.

Travelling is now very different compared to prior versions. For example, travelling long distances in the used car will result in horrible amounts of tension gain. Buying higher tier vehicles will actually be of use to you now.

Let us know if you like the changes we've made so that we can keep improving the game.

Panos, quick update
Hello everyone,

Lots of cool stuff will be added soon to the game, including backdrops for the gig places you are going to perform in, drum sets, props and hopefully soon I will start working on performance animations while Seabass works on the rhythm part of the game. Thank you all for being patient and giving us great feedback, we appreciate it and want you to keep it up.

Changelog Version 0.5.6.9

New stuff
Appealing trait system implemented
Added 2 new appealing events
Storyline system implemented
Added 3 new story events
Home system implemented
Added 1 new home, "Apartment0", gives -7 tension at the end of each day
Game now auto-detects missing/added game saves and corrects the save cache, no more clicking a save file to no prevail
Added song writing
Added informative tooltips for the shop
Changed audio options to include soundtrack options


Bug fixes
Fixed issue with msg_event_minor_21
Once a character action is completed, the game is saved
Fixed duping with prop placement, exiting the game without doing any other actions after placing props would result in duplicated props once the game is restarted
Fixed character randomization bug on alternative character editor menu, tattoos and other various character items wouldn't be purchasable but the game would take your money
Tension gain from character actions has been fixed, previously it generated a lot more tension than intended due to code issues


Minor changes and balancing
Removed "Lustful" trait
Garage rent now caps out at $500 and instead of increasing at $25 each month, it increases at $50 per month
The "Garage" home now gives -5 tension at the end of each day
Changed day and night cycle sprites to be more optimal and work with future homes
Song selling has been nerfed, the max scaled value for a song was $750 previously but is now $250
The "Refine Skills" character action has received a massive boost, previously you gained 2 - 4 xp per completed action, you now gain 10 - 25 xp per completed action (Refine skills only affects musicality and instrument skill)
The "Busking" character action now causes tension gain between that member and other bandmates, 2% tension gain per completed action
Updated Steamworks SDK from 1.32 to 1.39


A new home? Story events?
At last we have started writing/planning out the story line for Rock God Tycoon. We would like to emphasize that the game is mainly a sandbox game but there is a gentle line of story events that will help you progress through the game. Along with the story comes a new home, cozy Apartment 0. What an original name! We plan to add more details to each home as the game is further developed.



The shop items explained at last!
Since the original release day of Rock God Tycoon items have always been a mystery because we overlooked showing details about the items within the shop. Thanks to some user requests that has been changed. You can now read details about items via tooltips. Hover your mouse over any item in the shop and it'll show you a short message explaining exactly what that item does.



Adding your songs to the user playlist
When you save your songs in the song creator, they'll be copied into a folder called Song Data that can be found in %localappdata%/rockgodtycoon. All you have to do is copy the songs you want from the Song Data folder into the Music Player folder. Next time you start the game or toggle on the User Only soundtrack option, you'll hear your own rockin' tracks.


As always make yourself heard and let us know what you think!

You do NOT have to start a new game to experiene these changes. Save files have been made compatible since the day of release. This will be continued for as long as possible.

notes.title: Update 0.5.6.8, New events, bug fixes, and balancing!
notes.content:
An update, at last!
A lot of people have spoken up and discussed the lack of balance in certain areas of the game. We want to thank each of you for contributing to the development prcoess.

For those of you who have already played the game a fair bit, we recommend reading through the changelog below, travelling was broken up until now. It has been completely rebalanced and fixed to allow short travel without too much tension gain.

What about song writing?
We are still finalizing song writing. At this moment, we need a few more art assets and I need to clean up/polish some of the code. I think it is a fair estimate to say it should be in the next update, or the one following that one. At this moment, we are just trying to get back into the swing of things.

Changelog Version 0.5.6.8

New stuff
Klepto event system implemented
2 new klepto events
4 new minor events

Bug fixes, Optimizations
Fixed bug, character randomization wasn't calculating the price of clothing properly.
Fixed issue, clicking the pause menu buttons before the menu finished transitioning caused a crash
Fixed bug/design issue with hired band members, it has been disabled for hired bandmates but remains active for your character.
Fixed bug, Van now travels at intended speed
Fixed bug, clothing/instrument purchases are now cleared from memory when you quit a game
Fixed bug, travelling now uses vehicles travel speed in equation properly
Fixed bug, travelling without certain band members being hired would result in tension not being added to certain roles
Fixed possible crash when saved game gets corrupted (in some rare cases)
Cleaned up memory on exit in hopes of preventing game crash on exit (doesn't work but might help in future builds)

Balancing
Balance changes have been made to travelling, 5% is the minimum for tension gain (used to be 20%), the amount of tension gained from travel is higher in general though,this all not counting the vehicles travel speed into the equation
Travel times for vehicles have been modified, the "Car (Used)" is a lot slower now and all other vehicles will now be quite a bit faster

If you crash on exit, go to this folder location %localappdata%\CrashDumps and delete the files there. Each crash results in a 10mb dump file being generated which adds up fast. We are awaiting an engine update at the moment but we assume the next update will fix the crashing issue.

You do NOT have to start a new game to experiene these changes. Save files have been made compatible since the day of release. This will be continued for as long as possible.

notes.title: Update 0.5.4.3 New cities, bug fixes, and polish
notes.content:
First off, we would like to thank you all for the amazing feedback and endless patience. We've not had a single negative interaction yet and so we really have to thank all of you for that.

Some important changes to take notice of...
We've lowered the price of the used car to $2,250 instead of $3,500. This is so you can choose to purchase it early on and not get a game over as a result.

Rent now increases by $20 a month until it reaches $2,000. This will force players to leave the beginning city but also increase the challenge of the game to match your progression. We aren't sure exactly how this will actually affect things but we want to try it out so let us know what you think!

Panos (Artist)
Hey guys, just want to let you know that I am focusing on creating a lot more instruments right now, starting with guitars. I will create iconic guitars from famous guitarists as well as some designs of my own. You can join our public Discord since I am asking for suggestions from time to time, so if you have a specific design on mind let me know there.

Seabass (Programmer)
I've been putting about 85% of my time into bug fixing. I think the majority of issues have all been addressed but more will appear as we move forward. On the side of all of that though, I've been focusing on balance and polish.

An example of this is the new notifications (artwork thanks to Panos). It seems a lot of people weren't aware of the hiring date or when rent was due. This should make it a bit more obvious.
http://i.imgur.com/K3U9ARQ.png

Another polishing touch I've implemented (due to a suggestion from one you awesome people) is a way to see the city, event, and time you have booked. This should be really helpful when you have are planning out your week.
http://imgur.com/nUkuTPD.gif

I'd like everyone to be aware that we do know that tension needs to be explained better and shown in a more convenient fashion. We are deciding the best way to do and you will see it added in the next update.

Changelog 0.5.4.3
Added 3 new cities,
Santa Fe - 1 gig, 1 record label
Bismarck - 1 gig, 1 video clip studio
Flagstaff - 1 gig, 1 video clip studio
Band hires now only apply for available positions
Time remains paused (if it was previously paused) when returning to the garage screen
Studios can no longer be booked without first selecting at least one band member
Increased minimum bandmate salaries
Song preference list is now saved/loaded
Fixed bug, msg_event_minor_3
Can no longer hire bandmates once you have four bandmates
Dateboxes have tooltips that show event information

Band rating cache is now updated whenever you hire/fire band members
